accounting: Each experiment entry combines five independent trained replicas. Update/draw/wall-time counts are totals over the five. Sampled transitions counts critic minibatch draws, including repeats; actor/calibrator reuse does not create new source records. BCA additionally reuses its reserved 128-row bank at 18 refreshes per seed, 11520 score evaluations per five-seed condition. Final evaluation steps exclude separately recorded midpoint and designed-query diagnostics.
